item.title: My First Startup Experience
item.description: After finishing my BSc in Physics, my first job was at Network Elements Inc (NEI). in Beaverton, Oregon. Network Elements was a technology company focused on networking solutions and 10Gb/s and 40GB/s optical components. I joined as employee #21 and the first new grad hire on the team. That made the experience memorable from the beginning: I was walking into a small company where nearly everyone around me had already built a significant amount of technical and professional experience. The three founders and most the early team were from Tektronix and had many years of design and development experience.
